what_it_does: Moment is a system that optimizes how large graph neural network data is distributed across multiple graphics processing units (GPUs) for training. Graph neural networks process data structured as interconnected nodes and edges. The system jointly optimizes two aspects: the physical communication network topology connecting the GPUs, and how data is divided and placed across them. By treating network links as a capacity-constrained resource and formulating the problem as a maximum-flow problem (a graph algorithm), Moment reduces the communication bottleneck that typically limits training speed.
